incidents.name: Minto Finance signature replay
incidents.notes: The Minto claim contract verifies an operator signature but does not consume a nonce, so a previously used signature could be replayed to claim the reward repeatedly.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim proxy 0xdbf1c56b2ad121fe705f9b68225378aa6784f3e5 created 2023-02-20T10:15:38Z by 0x0529ac44cc4ebfa46d7c2256e4d8be171031fdca, unrelated to attack sender 0x547fb3db0f13eed5d3ff930a0b61ae35b173b4b5; the single EIP-1967 Upgraded event is the one emitted at construction, so the deployment timestamp is the last change. Loss verified onchain: 9,646.45 USDT left 0x11bd737757b86c16646313fdf9e86681dd3f065f to 0xc5001f60db92afcc23177a6c6b440a4226cb58bf.
